description: BUG B of the reduce_while_cont arg-shape family (fz-k22.10 is Bug A). enum_predicate_search run/build fail the cranelift verifier: reduce_while_cont__e152__branch_3 (a dispatch ARM) direct-calls a shared body passing 4 args to a 5-param tail-CC callee. native_direct_call_target_and_args (native.rs:1436-1470) builds the arg vector by zipping the call sites args against the callees executable_input_bindings (native.rs:4565-4589) with NO length check -- so a mismatch reaches cranelift as a malformed-arity call instead of being caught as a fatal pre-codegen error. CANDIDATE ORIGIN (not pinned): a CallEdge::Dispatch arm resolving to the wrong sibling instantiation -- an ExecutableKey whose input-binding count does not match what the CALLING clause was analyzed against. Check whether the arg-count used to build BackendCallArgs at the call site derives from the SAME activation as the callees executable_input_bindings. Exposed on enum_predicate_search now, and on enum_take_drop_split once Bug A (fz-k22.10) lands. Greening either fixtures run/build needs BOTH A and B. Add a pre-codegen length-check that fatals (never a malformed cranelift call) as a guard regardless.

comments.text: SAME ROOT as fz-k22.10: the 4-vs-5-arg is the SYMPTOM of the coalescing keeping the wrong (arbitrary) activation, so the callsite projects args for one specialization while calling another. The real fix is fz-k22.10 (key coalescing by full ActivationKey). This ticket's native.rs args/input_bindings length-check (native_direct_call_target_and_args ~1442) stays as a last-resort pre-codegen FATAL guard (never a malformed cranelift call) but is NOT the fix.

title: fz-k22: reduce_while_cont dispatch-arm direct call builds a 4-arg vector for a 5-param callee -- no length check zipping args against executable_input_bindings
